name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – CDO Leg 3
short_description: A multi-distance run (5km to 32km) organized by Runrio, set for September 20, 2026 at SM City CDO Uptown in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – CDO Leg 3 is a running event scheduled for September 20, 2026, at SM City CDO Uptown in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, it offers multiple distance options of 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon, the primary distance), 10km, and 5km. Registration details have not yet been announced.

research_highlights: CDO Leg 3 offers 5K, 10K, 21K and 32K distance categories, with the 32K being the marquee distance for Leg 3 of the series.
Venue is SM City CDO Uptown, and post-race the organizers direct finishers back to the mall for refreshments and photo spots.
Bib numbers must be worn visibly on the front with the B-Tag timing device on the back; runners without a properly displayed bib risk not having times recorded.
No skates, strollers, or animals are permitted on course, and face-covering costumes or bulky outfits are disallowed for safety.
Official results are posted about two days after race day via trilogyrunasia.com.
research_watchouts: Local coverage of the CDO leg focuses mainly on crowd energy and atmosphere rather than detailed course conditions, so specific hazards (elevation, road surface, water stations) are not well documented in public commentary.
The organizer reserves the right to change, delay, cancel, or suspend the event due to inclement weather or other safety risks.

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – CDO Leg 3 taking place?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. It will be held at SM City CDO Uptown in Cagayan de Oro, Philippines, as part of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series organized by Runrio.

faqs.question: What distances can participants run?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance options: 5km, 10km, 21.1km (half-marathon), and 32km. The 21.1km half-marathon is listed as the primary distance for this leg of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by Runrio, operating under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand. This CDO Leg 3 event is part of a broader series held across different locations under the same organizing brand.
